frozen_family.name: q=4 Morgenstern Cayley Ramanujan family
frozen_family.lift: MAJ3 on each edge variable using the existing exact truth-table CNF lift

frozen_execution.cache_key_time: after exhaustive pre-unit propagation and before local Resolution
frozen_execution.branch_rule: unchanged deterministic most-frequent-variable rule with frozen tie-break and value order
frozen_execution.cache_rule: reuse only a byte-identical residual completed earlier in DFS order
frozen_execution.unfolding: replace each cache edge by a fresh copy of its referenced completed residual subexecution

definitions.T_t: the full no-cache unfolding of the frozen Policy-0A execution on the MAJ3-lifted odd-charge Tseitin instance over G_t
definitions.R: a canonical residual key occurring after exhaustive pre-unit propagation in T_t
definitions.C_t_R: the set of distinct reachable normalized execution contexts in T_t whose cache key is exactly R
definitions.semantic_preimage: all partial assignments inducing a residual relation, whether or not visited by the frozen execution
definitions.execution_fiber: reachable contexts only; semantic preimages that are not visited do not count

exact_prior_lemmas: exact truth-table CNF commutes with restriction
MAJ3 two-coordinate 01 and 10 restrictions both equal the remaining coordinate
fully eliminated MAJ3 blocks retain only their effective edge output at the local relation level
eliminated edge outputs affect remaining Tseitin charges through the GF(2) incidence syndrome
one syndrome coset has 2^beta(H) edge-output preimages where beta(H) is cycle rank
therefore semantic preimage capacity may be exponential and is not itself an execution-fiber bound

primary_candidate.name: SUBEXPONENTIAL_REACHABLE_COSET_FIBER
primary_candidate.statement: There exists epsilon_t -> 0 and a polynomial p such that for every t and every reachable canonical residual R, m_t_R <= p(L_t)*2^(epsilon_t*L_t), where L_t is the exact lifted input length.
primary_candidate.sufficient_consequence: If proved, the C022 unfolded 2^{Omega(L_t)} work lower bound transfers through exact caching up to the separately charged polynomial bookkeeping factor, conditional on the unchanged C022 proof-system premises.

decisive_falsifier.statement: Exhibit and prove an infinite subsequence t_j and reachable residuals R_j with m_tj_Rj >= 2^(c*L_tj) for one constant c>0.
decisive_falsifier.effect: FAIL_CACHE_FIBER_TRANSFER_ROUTE; C022 no-cache lower bound remains untouched.

proof_obligations: P1_NORMALIZED_CONTEXT: define a context canonically from branch decisions plus forced unit assignments and prove that two visits counted in one fiber are distinct normalized contexts over the same eliminated/dead-variable semantics.

P2_LOCAL_RESTRICTION_CLASSIFICATION: prove the complete equivalence classes of MAJ3 restrictions relevant to equal canonical residuals, including stifled coordinates that become semantically dead before being assigned.

P3_GLOBAL_PARITY_COMPATIBILITY: characterize exactly how local constant-output differences compose through the two endpoint Tseitin constraints and the cycle space; do not assume blockwise equality where only a syndrome equality is forced.
P4_REACHABILITY: separate all semantic representatives from representatives actually realizable under the frozen deterministic branch/UP/local-Resolution dynamics.

P5_COLLISION_RANK: define an exact collision-rank/information-loss quantity for reachable contexts and prove either o(L_t) upper bound for every residual or Omega(L_t) lower bound on an explicit reachable residual family.
P6_CACHE_FIBER: derive m_t_R <= 2^(collision_rank(R))*poly(L_t) or an exact stronger relation, with every non-binary multiplicity factor charged explicitly.
P7_TOTAL_ACCOUNTING: charge construction/discovery/proof/replay/bit complexity in original lifted input length.
allowed_reasoning: graph expansion facts already source-bound for the frozen family
symbolic recurrences proved for all t
finite computation only as counterexample search or independent replay of a theorem-derived identity
forbidden: curve fitting or extrapolation from K4/K3,3/small t
probabilistic or average-case assumptions about branch contexts
post-result modification of the theorem statement to fit observed data
counting all semantic preimages as if they were reachable
assuming cache hits are ordinary Resolution DAG sharing
family labels or target truth as an oracle inside the frozen execution
uncharged global SAT solving or exhaustive search over the full assignment cube
required_controls: CACHE_DIAMOND remains an exact negative control showing generic exact caching can have exponential fibers
MAJ3-K4 m_max=128 remains revealed diagnostic only and cannot determine an asymptotic exponent
any proposed invariant must be checked against the exact 01/10 MAJ3 stifling collision and cycle-space collision mechanisms before promotion
